title: Firewood on a utility trailer (side view)
blurb: A working load of split firewood. Watch the forward-blocking and weight-placement checks: the rules engine flags what the geometry shows and refuses the rest.
photo_credit: Development photo, openly licensed (see repo docs). Inputs: bed 8 ft, load 8 ft.

calibration.axis: x (front at bed_min_x, rear at bed_max_x)
calibration.method: pixels-per-inch = trailer_bed mask bitmap tight extent along x (3038 px) / user-supplied bed length (8.0 ft = 96 in)

measurements.name: rear_overhang
measurements.method: rearmost cargo extent (mask bitmap tight edge, else bbox) minus the bed rear edge, scaled by the calibration; rear = image-right end of the bed extent

measurements.name: load_centroid_vs_axle
measurements.method: bitmap-weighted centroid of all cargo masks along the bed axis vs the axle estimate position (midpoint of axle centres when several), scaled by the calibration; positive offset = centroid behind the axle
measurements.confidence_basis: cargo det-0002-0cb127 conf 0.66; cargo det-0003-8035dc conf 0.70; cargo det-0004-58ef04 conf 0.69; cargo det-0005-d5a954 conf 0.69; cargo det-0006-92a9bc conf 0.59; cargo det-0007-cbdd6d conf 0.61; cargo det-0008-8e3779 conf 0.62; axle_estimate axle-0009-c97486 conf 0.92

uncertainty.basis: one bitmap-weighted standard deviation of the cargo pixels along the bed axis (the load's own spread), floored at 2 in; a photo shows where the bulk sits, not how heavy it is

measurements.name: tarp_coverage
measurements.method: tarp/canvas mask area overlapping the cargo area, as a percentage of the cargo area (bitmap union on the image canvas)
measurements.reason: load type is 'firewood', not loose material; the tarp check only applies to loose loads

measurements.name: tiedown_coverage_gaps
measurements.method: tie-down anchor positions mapped onto the bed axis (anchor centre x in bed coordinates); spans between neighbouring anchors and the bed ends, scaled by the calibration
measurements.reason: no tie-down detections in this detection set: tie-downs are counted from anchor close-up photos plus tap-to-correct, and close-up coordinates live in the close-up photo's own image space, so they cannot be placed on this photo's bed axis

notes: load_centroid_vs_axle is a visual estimate of where the load's bulk sits; it is not a weight measurement

verdicts.finding: The load can slide forward: its front edge is 8.6 in behind the front of the bed with nothing shown blocking it. Under hard braking that gap is how far the load can surge.
verdicts.minimum_fix: Block the front of the load: shift it forward against the headboard or bulkhead, or place secured blocking so the open gap is under 6 in.
verdicts.confidence_basis: front gap derived deterministically from the Day 2 calibration (bed front edge, pixels-per-inch) and the frontmost cargo extent (cargo det-0006-92a9bc)
verdicts.fix: Block the front of the load: shift it forward against the headboard or bulkhead, or place secured blocking so the open gap is under 6 in.

verdicts.finding: This load needs 2 tie-down(s) for its length (8 ft), but no tie-downs could be counted: tie-downs are counted from anchor close-up photos plus any you mark by tapping them on the photo, and neither was supplied. Full-frame photos cannot count straps reliably (they are too thin to read at that distance).
verdicts.confidence_basis: no close-up detection set and no user tie-down marks supplied

verdicts.cfr_citation: 49 CFR Part 393, Subpart I (overhang; lights and plate visibility)
verdicts.finding: Overhang: the load ends at or inside the rear of the bed (0 in overhang). Lights and plate: not checked (needs the rear photo read by the cross-check; segmentation cannot judge whether lights or the plate are obscured).
verdicts.citation: 49 CFR Part 393, Subpart I (overhang; lights and plate visibility)

verdicts.cfr_citation: 49 CFR 393.100 (load placement; visual estimate only here)
verdicts.finding: Photo estimate puts the load's bulk 22.7 in behind the axle, more than the +/-19.7 in uncertainty of the estimate: the load reads rear-heavy, which unloads the tongue and can make the trailer sway. This is a visual estimate of where the bulk sits, not a weight measurement.
verdicts.minimum_fix: Shift the load forward so its bulk sits over or ahead of the axle, then recheck with a new photo.
verdicts.confidence_basis: cargo det-0002-0cb127 conf 0.66; cargo det-0003-8035dc conf 0.70; cargo det-0004-58ef04 conf 0.69; cargo det-0005-d5a954 conf 0.69; cargo det-0006-92a9bc conf 0.59; cargo det-0007-cbdd6d conf 0.61; cargo det-0008-8e3779 conf 0.62; axle_estimate axle-0009-c97486 conf 0.92; visual estimate only
verdicts.citation: 49 CFR 393.100 (load placement; visual estimate only here)
verdicts.fix: Shift the load forward so its bulk sits over or ahead of the axle, then recheck with a new photo.

verdicts.finding: Edge protection cannot be judged from the evidence supplied: it needs a close-up of each strap where it crosses an edge, read for protectors. Take an anchor close-up per tie-down and run the cross-check.
verdicts.confidence_basis: no close-up cross-check evidence about straps over edges

verdicts.finding: Tie-down strength cannot be checked from the photo: a photo cannot verify working load limit ratings or load weight, and this check needs both numbers. Missing: no tie-down working load limit ratings were supplied; no load weight was supplied. Supply the load weight and each tie-down's rating and this check runs on those numbers.
verdicts.confidence_basis: not computable: no tie-down working load limit ratings were supplied; no load weight was supplied

report.headline: Firewood load needs forward blocking and better balance
report.body: Load can slide forward. Front edge is 8.6 in behind front of bed with nothing blocking it. Shift it forward against the headboard or bulkhead or place secured blocking so gap is under 6 in. Load reads rear-heavy. Estimate puts bulk 22.7 in behind axle, beyond 19.7 in uncertainty. Shift load forward so bulk sits over or ahead of axle, then recheck with new photo. Tie-down count could not be told. This 8 ft load needs 2 tie-downs but none could be counted without anchor close-ups or marks tapped on photo. Overhang lights and plate could not be fully told. Overhang is 0 in but lights and plate need rear photo cross-check. Edge protection could not be told without close-up of each strap at each edge. Tie-down strength could not be told without ratings and load weight. A photo cannot verify strap tension, tie-down ratings, or load weight.
